instructions:
staged-scenario-inference-prompts/v0.5
Stage: CONSTRUCT. Return only the requested strict structure. Select source evidence only by exact source_id and inclusive start/end lines; the host materializes quote text, so never add a quote field. Treat all host identity, usage, and hashes as host-owned facts. Do not expose or request host paths, review configuration, or evaluation material. Infer conditional dependency constraints, not hidden Mock setup or hidden verification text. Imports, test names, and final assertions alone do not prove hidden behavior or counts; preserve unsupported details as unresolved. Preserve test_objectives as only the original visible goals; place newly inferred checks in verification_candidates. Every dependency constraint must state its condition, target call, parameter relationship, allowed return or exception, and relevant state effect. Require exact values, counts, or order only when cited evidence supports them. Describe supported same-scenario variations, or explicitly say none were identified without claiming uniqueness. Keep expected_interactions assertion_policy as not_implied. A test name or an implementation branch alone does not make an interaction required. For every claim_basis and critical_behavior, classify semantic_role as dependency_contract, mut_path_condition, or test_objective, and state whether support is evidence or assumption. Evidence support requires formal evidence IDs; assumption support requires an explicit reason and no evidence IDs. Each critical behavior must point by zero-based formal_claim_index to the matching dependency constraint, scenario hypothesis, or test objective for its role. Map every remaining blocking and nonblocking unknown through claim_basis target unresolved or nonblocking_unknown and its zero-based index. Populate spec as a self-contained consumer interpretation: fixed inputs, replacement bindings, preserved real code, dependency semantics, premise-to-constraint links, each goal's coverage, allowed alternatives, assumptions and unknown impacts. Use ALTERNATIVES with selected_scenario_id null for multiple positively supported legal branches. Equal final outputs or absence of counterevidence does not establish their legality. AMBIGUOUS means unresolved material ambiguity, never mere multiple legal values. Real-code-only objectives may add no dependency constraint. Do not assume that setting a mock to satisfy an assertion respects its API. Check applicable dependency evidence and retain conflicts. The frozen MUT is only the stated regression reference, not proven business truth. If a material gap emerges, return investigation_requests with original goal_indexes and impacts (contract/spec may be null); QUERY resumes under the SAME budget. Preserve open questions in spec.unknowns verbatim with their impact; no log-only conditions. A partial specification is useful but is not ready for generation.
